prompts.regol-garden.webp: Use case: illustration-story. Create one standalone portrait background painting for an interactive Javanese wedding invitation named Sekar Jawa. Room 1: a serene Yogyakarta-inspired walled palace garden entered through a refined cream stone regol gate, old teak doorway open onto a winding pale path, distant joglo roof, lush mature trees, jasmine, ivory frangipani and subtle blush flowers. Genuine delicate traditional watercolor on warm ivory textured cotton canvas/paper, visible pigment granulation, softly bleeding brush edges, hand-painted loose foliage, poetic storybook depth. Muted olive and sage, warm stone, restrained antique gold and brown. Camera at human eye level, central open path and quiet pale middle area for layered wedding couple later. Rich layered foreground sides, midground gate, very distant hazy garden. Vertical 2:3 composition, naturally detailed but unmistakably watercolor not photograph, not 3D, not glossy, no people, no lettering, no border, no watermark. Image must fill canvas, no white page margins.

prompts.couple-original-reference: Use case: illustration-story. One full-length wedding couple cutout, transparent background. Authentic hand-painted watercolor on cotton paper, loose softly feathered edges, subtle granulation, romantic painterly faces, NOT photorealistic, NOT anime, NOT 3D. Young adult Javanese Indonesian bride and groom with natural Indonesian features, gentle affectionate gaze toward each other. Groom stands on LEFT wearing elegant dark chocolate/black Javanese beskap with restrained antique-gold embroidery, brown sogan batik jarik, traditional blangkon and elegant footwear. Bride stands on RIGHT wearing ivory/gold Javanese kebaya, brown sogan batik long skirt, neat traditional dark updo with jasmine ronce strands, delicate golden hair ornaments, holding small ivory jasmine bouquet. Both entire bodies including feet visible, facing slightly inward together, correct hands and graceful anatomy. Muted cream/olive/teak palette, no scene, no background, no floor, no text, no border, no checkerboard. Actual transparent alpha.
prompts.couple-cover.webp: Edit target: the supplied watercolor Javanese wedding couple. Keep the couple identities, side-by-side affectionate gaze, clothing, left/right arrangement, full bodies and feet unchanged. Remove ALL background haze, brown glow, vignette, cast shadows and color outside their silhouettes. Surrounding pixels must be genuinely fully transparent alpha, no backdrop or floor. Preserve watercolor pigment and slightly loosen painterly edges without blurring faces. Keep all jasmine ornaments. No text.
prompts.couple-hero.webp: Edit target: the supplied Javanese wedding couple. Create a matching full-length portrait of the SAME couple, same faces, same black/gold beskap and brown sogan batik, bride same ivory/gold kebaya with jasmine ronce and hair ornaments. Groom remains LEFT and bride RIGHT. Change their pose so BOTH faces look straight toward the viewer with a soft welcoming smile; bride holds jasmine bouquet centrally, the pair stand close. Entire bodies and footwear visible, graceful correct anatomy. Delicate visibly hand-painted watercolor, cotton paper pigment texture inside figures, soft painted edges; not a photo. Genuinely transparent alpha outside the figures, NO brown glow, NO vignette, NO background haze, NO background, NO floor or cast shadow. No text.
prompts.jasmine-canopy.webp: Use case: illustration-story. A single transparent foreground frame layer for a watercolor Javanese palace garden. Vertical 2:3 composition. Fine loose branches and olive/sage tropical leaves enter softly from the TOP LEFT and TOP RIGHT CORNERS, a few ivory jasmine strands and frangipani blossoms, sparse soft leaves at bottom left and bottom right. Large fully empty transparent central area occupying 75% of image. Delicate light watercolor pigment on cotton-paper texture inside foliage, muted olive sage and warm ivory with tiny antique-gold accents. Fully transparent background/alpha, no paper rectangle, no scene, no buildings, no brown halo or shadows, no text, no hard border.
